text:
Sam: quick poll for the room  what's the weirdest thing in your laptop bag right now?
Jo: A tiny rubber chicken. I keep forgetting why I bought it. :joy:
Eli: Spare pair of socks. Flights + AC = unpredictable.
Sam: @Jo please explain the chicken origins.
Jo: It was a whiteboard prize from a hackathon. Now it guards my cables.
Eli: care-bot: any workplace guidance on bringing novelty items to the office?
care-bot: care-bot: Keep it tidy, avoid food that attracts pests, and be kind to colleagues who dislike squeaky toys.
Sam: Vote: rubber chicken, socks, emergency charger, or mystery note? React :one:/:two:/:three:/:four:.
Jo: :one: chicken (of course)
Eli: :two: socks
Sam: :three: charger (practical but boring)
Jo: thanks team  now I know I'm not the only one with oddities in the bag.
